Also need norm broadcast every 5 rounds: rounds 1,6,11,16...? Starting round1. So round 6 broadcast, round11 broadcast, round12 not due.

Also we can send praise to contributors >=60% of wallet. Our wallet high, but need their contribution relative to their wallet? We don't know their wallets. But we can praise known high contributor like Resident3 contributed 1140.6 which is >60% of initial endowment? Probably yes. So send private message praising Resident3.

We also need to contribute 80% of wallet: amount = 0.8*1974.16 = 1579.328. Use round action contribute that amount.

We can also punish one target. Allowed one physical action only; choose contribute or punish but not both. The rule says choose at most one physical action. So we must pick either contribute or punish. We want to follow constitution: baseline contribution required. Punish also required for free rider. Might need to prioritize contribution? We can only do one. Perhaps we choose contribute, and skip punish this round (punish later). That is okay.

Send private praise to Resident3.
